title: Teardrop-shaped transmedium UAP video shown in a joint task force SCIF
place_text: Over the ocean; joint task force overseas

tellings.quote: observing this teardropshaped looking UAP that might have been 20 ft lengthwise or so and it was traveling under the ocean water

plain: A video is said to show a teardrop-shaped unidentified object, maybe 20 feet long, moving under the ocean and also flying, shown inside a secure room for secret material at a military joint task force overseas. Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy admiral, tells it, saying the video came attached to an email from a naval intelligence commander. If true, it would mean an unknown craft can move between sea and sky.
